headline: IONQ Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Beat, Stock Rises
summary: IONQ posts a wider-than-expected Q2 loss but tops revenue estimates, raises its 2026 revenue outlook and sees shares rise after the results.

headline: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on AMETEK, Raises Price Target to $316
summary: Truist Securities  analyst Jamie Cook   maintains AMETEK (NYSE:AME) with a Buy and raises the price target from $303 to $316.
